extras.approval_status: DRAFT — measures alignment with each person's own REAL klub (pardubice:org:group:* rows from pardubice/scripts/party_affiliation.py, derived from the per-vote klub column, canonicalized, mode-per-meeting + contiguous-run intervals). Independent of which klubs form the government, so it does not need the same D7 sign-off as govity/wpca — ready to use as-is.
extras.note: Needs each person's klub membership at each vote-event date, from data/memberships.csv's pardubice:org:group:* rows via the all-members-shaped persons file the runner builds.
extras.known_data_quality_notes: 9 klubs after canonicalization (ANO 2011, NAŠE PARDUBICE, Nezávislá/SPD, Piráti, Progresivní Pce, SPD, SPOLU, SpP, ŽP). Piráti is renamed 'Progresivní Pce' from meeting 38 (2026-05-25) and modeled as two adjacent klub orgs; Slezák + Müller move SPOLU -> Progresivní Pce at the same meeting. Helena Dvořáčková alternates 'SPD' / 'Nezávislá/SPD' meeting to meeting in 2022-2023 (an independent on the SPD list) -> a few short intervals. See work/reports/party_affiliation_report.json's open_questions_for_owner.
